name: Abat

routes.outcome: First-party Akwa Ibom State Government-linked AkwaGIS portal identified; it describes itself as the official GIS and digital land-administration platform for Akwa Ibom.

Official public land-search page states that records can be validated by Land PIN or plan/COD number; full parcel details are payment-gated. No coordinate or map-extent search was exposed in the public page.

Official platform description identifies the Ministry of Lands and Office of the State Surveyor General operational context and describes statewide aerial/geospatial mapping. This is institutional context, not a returned parcel feature.
Official FAQ identifies AkwaGIS as the Akwa Ibom State GIS land-administration platform and says it operates under the Ministry of Lands.
TLS-verified GET returned HTTP 200. Current Next.js page inspection exposed the public-search form, Land PIN example, plan/COD alternative, and no viewer configuration or coordinate parcel endpoint.

TLS-verified GET returned HTTP 200. Anonymous service metadata confirmed active PUBLIC_SEARCH, described as lookup by Land PIN or plan/COD number, priced at NGN 500. Response contained service/workflow metadata only; no parcel identity or geometry.

Current JavaScript/configuration inspection found API base path /api/v1 and routes /search/validate, /search/initiate, /search/transactions/{id}, and parcel detail routes. No coordinate/extent route was found. No login, credential, CAPTCHA, or certificate bypass was used.
